channel.title: Veria Labs
channel.description: Veria AI is an autonomous pentester: it maps your entire attack surface, proves real exploits, and drafts the fix.

item.title: Hacking a16z: Breaking Jolt and Dory
item.description: How our agent found a full proof forgery in Jolt, a16z's zkVM.

item.title: A Technical Breakdown of Jolt's Cryptography (and the exploit)
item.description: The mathematics of the missing Dory commitments behind the Jolt exploit.

item.title: How Veria AI Found an Arbitrary Proof Forgery in Aleo
item.description: How a weak Fiat-Shamir transcript allowed arbitrary transaction forgery on Aleo, and earned us a $65,000 bounty.

item.title: Pwning Pydantic's Monty: A $5K Sandbox Escape
item.description: Pydantic offered $5,000 to escape Monty, their Rust-built Python sandbox for AI agents. We chained two GC bugs into a use-after-free and walked away with the bounty.

item.title: Securing Open Source Part 2: Cracking Kraken
item.description: Malicious dApps can impersonate trusted apps and disguise Solana transactions as harmless message signatures, allowing potential fund theft when chained together.

item.title: Securing Open Source Part 1: Goose 1-Click RCE
item.description: We found a 1-click RCE in Block's Goose AI agent: any website could silently execute commands on your machine.

item.title: Announcing our $3.2M Seed Round
item.description: We spun out of the #1 hacking team in the US and raised a $3.2M seed to make getting hacked a thing of the past.

item.title: Breaking FRI in Eigen's zkVM
item.description: How missing index checks in FRI allow full proof forgery in Eigen's zkVM.

item.title: From MCP to Shell
item.description: How MCP authentication flaws enable RCE in Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and more.
